mostWorthwhile.text: Linking river migration to a sheltered oasis was worthwhile: it showed that moving through climate change requires both a route and a suitable destination.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating the oasis was predictable and gave no explanatory detail on its own, though the next combination made it meaningful.

surprise.text: The contrast between inherited variation preceding cold and migration toward warmer country made the multiple ways through the ice age clearer.

arbitrary.text: Combining the oasis with cold-adapted populations had a clear goal of bringing survival paths together, but the resulting surviving lineages offered little detail about that connection.

continue.text: Yes. The distinct survival paths and the acknowledgement of loss make me curious how the changed world develops, although the predictable intermediate combinations are less engaging.
